caption: The drawing depicts a group of figures gathered around a large wooden cross positioned in the center of the composition. At the top of the cross, a sign with the letters "INRI" is visible. A person, dressed in a long white garment, is standing on a ladder placed against the cross, appearing to lower the body of another figure, which is draped over a woman's lap at the base of the cross. The woman has a blue head covering and a red robe. Surrounding her are several figures, mostly wearing robes or cloaks of green, red, or white, with some figures having beards and one kneeling in grief. Three male figures on the right side of the drawing wear red garments decorated with white details and tall, ornate red hats with white patterns. These figures hold spears. On the left side, two more figures wear similarly tall red-and-white hats, while another person is draped in green and white with a white beard. The background consists of dark green and reddish brown colors with white cloud-like shapes near the top, and spears or staffs extending upward behind the central group. The color palette features earthy tones, with strong use of red, green, white, and flesh colors for the figures' faces and limbs.
title: Station of the Cross No. 13: "Jesus is Taken Down from the Cross"
